profile.headline: Software Engineer at UnitedHealth Group
profile.summary:
Software engineer with more than five years of experience in building web applications and testing frameworks. 

Proficient: JavaScript, React, Redux, Node.js, Express, Java, Spring Boot, MongoDB, MySQL, Enzyme, Jest, Mocha, HTML5, CSS3, Sass, Sketch, Git

Exposure: ​Docker, AWS, Heroku, Firebase, Circle CI, Jenkins, Selenium, Nightwatch.js, Invision, Google Analytics

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
AcceptMyCrypto is created with a mission to help solve one of the biggest problems in cryptocurrencies - bring cryptocurrencies to mass adoption. 

Created initially as a social eCommerce platform for cryptocurrencies, we want to provide a place where people can shop for deals and be connected using cryptocurrencies.   

Fundamentally, cryptocurrencies are another form of exchange, powered by blockchain technology. They tick all the boxes when you compare all the different functions and aspects of fiat currency - Fungible, Durable, Scarce, Divisible, and Trade. 

Why we believe Cryptocurrency will replace Fiat Currency?

Cryptocurrencies can provide a Decentralized and Fairer Financial Systems.

Check us out at acceptmycrypto.com and be notified when we launched officially.

positions.title: Software QA Engineer
positions.description:
OneMob is your digital experience platform enabling businesses to improve their customer experience and engagement. Backed by Salesforce Ventures and awarded 2015 Gartner "Cool Vendors" in CRM Sales, OneMob allows users to connect and engage with all forms of digital content, our favorite is video. Everything is tracked in Salesforce and our customers are seeing a 15x in email CTRs and 5x in response rates.

OneMob is great for the entire customer lifecycle, starting with sales prospecting (putting a face to a name), and all the way to customer support/renewals (people like to buy and renew from people they know).

Try it today at http://www.onemob.com and see what we're up to at http://blog.onemob.com/
